prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” interior painting company for everyone — the right one depends on your budget, the size/age of the job, desired timeline, and whether you want extras (color consulting, repair work, faux finishes, etc.). I can, however, help you find the best option for your needs by giving a reliable way to choose and some practical next steps.

How to find the best interior painter in St. Louis
1. Search reputable sources
 - Google Business / Google Maps (look at ratings + recent photos)
 - Yelp and Angi (formerly Angie’s List)
 - Houzz (good for seeing portfolios)
 - Better Business Bureau for complaints and accreditation

2. Narrow to 3–5 candidates
 - Favor companies with lots of recent positive reviews and before/after photos of similar work.
 - Prefer painters who are licensed (if required locally), insured (general liability and workers’ comp), and—if your home is pre-1978—EPA Lead-Safe certified.

3. Ask for and compare written bids
 - Get at least three written estimates that list scope, prep, paint brand/finish, number of coats, timeline, start/end dates, cleanup, and warranty.
 - Don’t automatically pick the lowest bid — look for detail and thorough prep (patching, priming, caulking, sanding).

4. Check references and portfolio
 - Ask for recent local references (same kind of job) and call them.
 - Ask to see photos of completed rooms rather than just generic marketing shots.

5. Confirm logistics and guarantees
 - Ask about who will do the work (employees vs. subcontractors).
 - Confirm insurance and request proof.
 - Get the payment schedule (small deposit, final payment on completion).
 - Ask about touch-up policy and warranty on workmanship and paint.

Important questions to ask any painter
 - What surface prep will you do (patch, sand, prime)?
 - What brand and sheens of paint will you use? How many coats?
 - Will you move furniture and protect floors? How will you handle cleanup?
 - When can you start and how long will it take?
 - Can you provide proof of insurance, references, and a written contract?
 - Are you EPA Lead-Safe certified (if house built before 1978)?

If you want, I can:
 - Give a short list of top-rated St. Louis painters if you share your ZIP code or neighborhood (so I can focus on local options).
 - Draft a short message/email you can send to painters to request bids.
 - Help compare 2–3 written estimates you receive.

Which would you prefer?
